frase_gancho.texto: A pedestrian street where palaces, churches, jewelry shops and time-honored candy stores live side by side.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: This is the most walked street in the Historic Center. It was once known as San Francisco and as Plateros, and today it bears the name Madero. In just a few blocks you go from the Casa de los Azulejos to the former Franciscan convent, from an eighteenth-century palace to a Jesuit church, and from there to businesses that have been open for decades. There are eleven stops, and several of them can be visited inside. Take your time: the rhythm of this area is set by its façades.
